summary: Operator site read: 32 full-hookup + 5 water/electric RV sites (the same page also says '40 spacious RV sites, all with full hookups'), seasonal sites, daily/weekly/monthly rates, showers, laundry, dump 'coming soon'; Campspot booking link confirmed. Campspot price not re-read (stored $47 from 2026-10-13 kept). OHV drop candidate: the operator markets an ATV trail system starting at the campground entrance.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (OHV rule): the operator's own homepage says 'Take full advantage of our ATV trail system, which begins right at the entrance of the campground' and 'Bring your ATV or boat ... with an ATV trail conveniently located at the entrance of the park for endless exploration'. The stored note already says it is 'connected to the Paul Bunyan State Forest ATV trails'.
Site count conflict on the operator's own page: '40 spacious RV sites, all with full hookups' vs '32 Full Hookup RV Sites Also 5 with water, Electric, No Sewer' (37). Stored count 40 left as derived.

Waterfront (operator claims the 'east side of Daisy Lake' / 'lakeside paradise'): keep not waterfront. On imagery the highway (County 2/US-71 corridor) runs between the campground and Daisy Lake, with a pine stand between the RV area and the road; the lake shore is ~150 m west of the pin across the road. A road between the sites and the water blocks any on-water value; no view across it was evident.

Long-stay: seasonal sites, weekly and monthly rates are marketed, but nightly sites are sold on Campspot ($47 Oct 2026). Google 4.7 from only 12 reviews (presence passes on the website + phone 218-255-1100, matching the entry). No gateway within 40 km; price $47 under US$50.

Website field: the stored second URL is https://www.campspot.com/park/daisy-lake-rv-campground; the operator's booking link and Google listing use https://www.campspot.com/book/daisy-lake-nevis (apply.py does not write websites).
